answer_1.quote: Specifically, we utilize the cloze-style query with a single [Mask] token as the model input. The model then predicts the answer entities that correspond to the [Mask] token in an autoregressive manner.
answer_1.outputs: Generated answers for cloze-style biomedical knowledge queries

answer_2.quote: Contrastive-Probe obtains absolute improvements by up-to ∼5% and ∼21% on the acc@1 and acc@10 probing performance

answer_4.quote: To assess whether the actual probing performance could be possibly higher than what is reflected by the commonly used automatic evaluation, we conducted a human evaluation on the prediction result.
answer_4.guideline: Assessors rated predictions on a scale of 1 to 5: 5-Perfectly answer the query; 4-Similar to the gold answer, could somehow be the answer; 3-Related to the query but not correct; 2-Same domain or slight relation; 1-Completely unrelated.
